About AGC

Premium products, presented with pride.

AGC Nigeria Limited is a Nigerian food business offering a selection of popular, familiar products for customers, families and food lovers. Our range brings together fresh eggs, plantain products, crunchy chin chin and peanuts in convenient packaging.

We believe buying everyday food should feel simple and professional. That is why our website makes it easy to see the products, check prices in Nigerian naira and send an order directly to the business.

“Quality you can see. Products you can enjoy. Service you can trust.”
